node.title: Upstream affine-span and rank-flat RS list compilers
node.statement: For an affine direction-s codeword flat in RS[F,D,K], the number of members agreeing with one received word on at least m=K+w coordinates is at most floor(C(n-K+s,s)/C(w+s,s)). With generalized direction-code weights d_j, common-zero miss count b, and t=n-m, the sharper cap is floor(d_s falling s / product_j(d_j-t+b)), where d_j>=n-K+j. This independently reconstructs upstream thm:affine-span-list and thm:rank-flat-list at b13de811.
